svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Slide: 3 mm plate 190 wide x 50 tall with a 16 mm knob at the left.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Guides: two strips 250 long built from 3 mm bar and a 3 mm lip,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: welded to the outside of the door plate above and below the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: secondary air slot, so the slide moves sideways between them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The slot is 150 x 20; the slide covers it with 15 to spare.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Loose fit, about 1 mm: it must move by hand when hot (gloves).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Secondary air enters above the fire bed and burns the gases off

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the wood; the primary slide sets the burning rate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the slide shuts the slot; the door still closes and latches.
